prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high craft art-direction concept for the MIDDLE of the Perry Mac assistant website. The supplied first image is the existing approved light hero: use it only as a brand/style reference. Second image is the approved footer concept: use it as the destination this middle must naturally lead into. Preserve warm off-white paper, confident black ink, sparse coral guidance, the specific small round-headed Perry character with two vertical eyes and short body/limbs. Accurate Mac-native UI geometry, subtle material, realistic Apple app icons if any, restrained shadow. Brand personality comes from Perry's actions and composition, not arbitrary rotated cards or extra decorations. No yellow concert poster, no fictional event brand, no feature-card grid, no AI gradients, no oversized generic SaaS dashboard, no dense wall of copy, no decorative badges, no invented product metrics. Illustrative concept, no need to assert real product capabilities. Make web compositions, not a photograph of a laptop. Use large readable type, excellent spacing, deliberately directed character poses. The images should help a designer assess continuity, focal hierarchy, warmth, visual rhythm and an engaging emotional arc. DIRECTION A: ONE CONTINUOUS TASK. Generate a tall premium website storyboard, three wide 16:9-ish screen compositions stacked vertically on the same continuous ivory canvas, no enclosing storyboard boxes or labels. These are consecutive moments of ONE evolving Mac desktop. Persistent faint mountain landscape at OUTER margins only and consistent camera/light. Use the same coastal photograph and the same native Preview window in all three moments, recognizable by pale ocean blue, a tiny red beach umbrella, and a pine headland. First composition: headline 'Right here with you.' small enough to leave room for the visual. A cropped-in native Mac contact sheet at right, a selected coastal photo and a small contextual Perry speech note 'This one?' Perry leans over the actual selected photo, pointing; the assistant relates to the object, not to whitespace. Second composition: flow downward as the SAME selected photo grows into a beautiful native Preview window, with one accurate crop selection and one coral corner; headline 'Here. Like this.' on left; Perry physically perched on the window edge holding one short coral guide that terminates at the crop handle. Spacious but engaged asymmetric layout, product action is main focus. Third composition: the same now-cropped photo becomes a clean final thumbnail beside two related thumbnails and a correctly drawn blue Mac folder 'Weekend'; small Perry approval bubble 'Put these together?' with a single clear 'Go ahead' button, and a compact visible completed result. Headline 'Want a hand with the rest?' Objects gently descend toward a partial Dock at bottom leading into existing footer. Do not show two states on top of each other in one screen. Close-up product evidence must be readable. At most ONE Perry per screen. The main ambition: a coherent, emotionally warm story with exquisite restraint, memorable composition and continuity; no repeated huge gray window holding a headline. Render a beautiful finished art direction board, tall portrait aspect.

Generate a tall three-scene web art-direction board on a SINGLE uninterrupted ivory desktop with very faint existing landscape drawing near outer edges. Take an expressive, character-led direction, distinct from sober window mockups. Desktop content exists at a believable scale but scenes use bold editorial composition and purposeful close-ups. Perry is the SAME small rounded ink creature as hero, with a stubby body and short limbs, never a long-legged stickman, and physically interacts with window edges, picture corners, and file thumbnails. First beat: headline 'A little less lost.' in large brush lettering upper left; right and center show an elegant, closely cropped authentic Mac application toolbar and a photograph of a misty coastal headland with a tiny coral umbrella. Perry peers around the application window edge and puts a small coral circle around the exact control being explained; a tiny handwritten 'this one' sits naturally by the mark. Second beat: the SAME toolbar/photo extends through the scroll; headline 'We can do it together.' set in clean confident sans with room to breathe. Window frame acts as a real perch; Perry braces with two feet and pulls the coral crop corner into place, conveying effort and companionship, a charming pose with a clear practical consequence. Use one oversized meaningful detail instead of stacks of floating cards. Third beat: headline 'There. All together.' The SAME photo now joins two related coastal thumbnails in an open blue Mac folder, Perry sits satisfied on its edge and points toward the partially entering familiar Dock from the approved footer. Maintain accurate native window controls and modest realistic icons; use no giant decorative Finder face. One continuous tiny coral gesture connects ONLY causal action points, not a long decorative dotted journey line. Typography, visible objects and Perry all interact spatially. Avoid three identical text/image layouts: use an intimate crop, a wide working view, then a quiet outcome. Preserve specific cozy black-ink world of the refs with enough humor to feel alive. Tall portrait, high finish, no labels explaining the direction, no moodboard furniture.
